title: Parallel Decoding Distillation for Fast Image and Video Generation
author: Neta Shaul; Chao Liu; Arash Vahdat; Julius Berner
summary: This paper explores a method called parallel decoding distillation to speed up image and video generation. The approach builds on recent advances in flow and diffusion models to make generation faster and more efficient. It shows promising results for one-step or few-step generation tasks in vision.
